control: TLS 1.3 mutual authentication and exact peer certificate pin; uint32 BE canonical JSON <=65536 bytes; methods: hello, register_ingress, admit, resolve_contributors, bind_context, open_relay, renew, close, checkpoint

readiness.lifetime: private 0600 exclusive-create, fsync before serving, refuse existing record; endpoint launcher supplies this exact boot ID to its pinned consumer

register_ingress.live_and_stored_semantics: accepts l1-<type>-<hex(canonical_channel_id)>-<message_id>-<message_seq>-<hex(from_uid)>-<observed_payload_sha256> live-ingress delivery references (or mints l1- via NativeReader.BindLiveIngress when live_ingress is supplied without delivery_reference) as well as s1-... stored delivery references; resolves purpose='admit' via NativeReader.Resolve; verifies exact stream, payload_sha256, and optional header/provenance; records both versioned and version-independent replay tombstones in seenDeliveries so duplicate deliveries across the unpersisted (l1-/live_unpersisted_v1) -> persisted (s1-/x0_0) transition are rejected with authority_conflict; forbids l2-, h1-, and c1- prefixes as delivery_reference

admit.context_reuse_semantics: when a completed bound context for (owner, proposed_context_id, key, scope_incarnation, context_epoch) exists on this host and optional prior_generation/context_generation (if supplied) matches that bound generation, admit reuses that generation ID for same-generation complete-contributor context reuse; if scope_incarnation or context_epoch rotated, or the prior turn did not complete, admit mints a fresh generation ID; Admit rechecks the live or stored trigger observation via NativeReader.Recheck (purpose='admit') without issuing any purpose='contributor' trigger-row reread

resolve_contributors.semantics: strict stored-message historical contributor resolution: rejects l1- and l2- unpersisted live-ingress tokens with predicate_unsupported and resolves stored s1-... contributor delivery references on an admitted capsule or verified key via NativeReader.Resolve with purpose='contributor' in batches <=32 without inserting into seenDeliveries ingress replay tombstones

bind_context.core_hash: bytes/sha256 cover canonical JSON of exactly context_id, context_generation, originals; originals are complete native Headers, including the invoking original (l2-... for live ingress or h1-... for stored ingress) and all resolved contributor Headers
bind_context.chunk_semantics: each bind_context frame uses manifest containing the chunk descriptor; bytes/hash fixed on first chunk, offset exactly accepted length, standard base64 <=32768 decoded bytes recommended; no truncation/replacement/path/URL; canonical full core verified before binding
bind_context.contributor_resolution: if optional contributor_references/delivery_references are supplied on bind_context before final chunk assembly completes, the host rejects any l1-/l2- live token and resolves any not-yet-resolved stored s1-... contributor references on the capsule via purpose='contributor' before verifying ObservedHeader and Stage 1 contributor intersection; during Recheck, the triggering original in manifest.originals reuses the just-resolved purpose='admit' observation without issuing a second purpose='contributor' query

tls_metadata.semantics: populated when include_tls_trust=true and host relay TLS trust material is configured; never disables TLS 1.3 verification

open_relay.http: production URL is HTTPS over PublicationTLSListener (TLS 1.3); handle is a 64-hex one-turn bearer; when relay TLS pins are present, reply includes ca_sha256 and peer_sha256, plus optional tls={ca_file, ca_sha256, cert_sha256, peer_sha256, server_name} when include_tls_trust=true; every HTTP response emits X-Octo-Acquisition-Budget-Bytes=<MaxSerializedRPCBytes> when ResponseBudgets are configured
open_relay.stdio: actual pinned CLI executes --turn-relay <handle>; handle is unpadded base64url of a closed JSON ticket <=512 characters containing {ca_sha256, endpoint, peer_sha256, token} plus optional server_name and optional max_response_bytes
open_relay.relay_executable: private config may name the pinned CLI; empty selects this executable; absolute regular non-writable executable required
open_relay.bearer_domain: 64 lowercase hex characters; ordinary bf_/app_/uk_ credentials are rejected by the relay ticket parser

wire_contracts_supported: Wire Contract B: NativeReader.Resolve -> POST /v1/bot/permission-facts/v1 (operation='resolve', purpose in {'admit','reply'} for l1-... and {'admit','contributor','reply'} for s1-...)
Wire Contract C: NativeReader.EvaluateCurrentAccess -> POST /v1/bot/permission-facts/v1 (operation='evaluate_current_access', purpose in {'admit','reply'})
zero_trigger_row_reread_invariants: NativeReader.Recheck resolves g.original.reference once with purpose='admit' and reuses current[0] for any manifest.originals entry matching g.original, eliminating the duplicate purpose='contributor' query on the triggering message at bind_context, open_relay, renew, BeginCall, RoundTrip/Execute, AdmitPageBytes, ConsumeBytes, ReadLocal, and Publish/PublishConnection
Distinct prior live-turn originals in a multi-turn context_generation resolve via purpose='admit' in batches <=32
Distinct stored historical contributors (s1-...) resolve via purpose='contributor' in batches <=32
HeaderV1 cross-read immutability (bytes.Equal(prior.raw, o.raw)) is enforced for both l2-... and h1-... observations
